title: Auth telemetry rationalization and post-incident remediation roadmap (RBACv2, SAML, Audit)
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: After the Feb 2026 auth incident we observed noisy RBAC deny alerts, delayed audit ingestion, and incomplete correlation between SAML assertion failures and RBAC policy denies. Goal: consolidate auth telemetry, establish clear SLOs and alert precision targets for RBACv2 and SSO, reduce false positives by 60%, and publish a tested runbook and retention/sampling policy. Deliverables: (1) structured auth event schema and tags, (2) tuned Grafana/Alertmanager rules, (3) updated audit ingestion capacity and backlog handling, (4) runbook + tabletop test, (5) privacy-compliant retention and sampling guidance.
comments: 2026-02-19 - Ava Chen: Kickoff sync completed. Agreed scope: RBACv2 event enrichment, SAML failure correlation, retention policy review. Action owners assigned.

2026-02-24 - Marco Alvarez: Initial spike finished. Prototype event schema submitted as Confluence draft. Found that 12% of auth events lack client_id and 4% missing assertion_id; will add required fields at ingestion stage.

2026-03-02 - Leah Patel (Security PM): Reviewed schema, requested PII redaction rule for SAML raw assertions. Raised security_review_required flag. Linking design note: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/Auth+Telemetry+Schema

2026-03-04 - Marco Alvarez: PR opened to add schema enforcement and tagging to audit-pipeline: https://github.com/redwood-inference/audit-pipeline/pull/3456. Benchmarked ingest lag; median 220ms, tail (p99) 2.1s on dev cluster.

2026-03-06 - Observability team (review): Proposed alert changes: move RBAC deny alert to anomaly-detector and add precision gating to reduce fakes. See dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/auth-overview

2026-03-08 - Ava Chen: Decision: implement 2-stage alerting: (A) high-sensitivity on expanded signal for detection, routed to ops channel with throttling; (B) high-precision alert for on-call only when correlated with SAML failure spike or service degradation. Rationale: reduces noise while preserving detection surface.

2026-03-10 - Marco Alvarez: Completed runbook draft and scheduled tabletop for 2026-03-24. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/Auth+Incident+Runbook. Need SME review from Identity team.
2026-03-10 - Security (review): Approved retention update for 90-day raw audit retention with 2-year indexed metadata retention, pending legal sign-off. Action: privacy team to review scrubber rules.
2026-03-10 - Marco Alvarez: Testing plan created: synthetic SAML fail injection, RBAC policy deny flood, and audit ingestion backlog simulation. Ticketing tests to be automated in CI after PR merge.
